source.title: Next: assemble the source material
source.description: Organize the novel, inspiration or input text into a synopsis, rhythm, characters and hard facts the drama can use.

strategy.title: Next: generate the drama strategy
strategy.description: From the material and track, generate audience positioning, the main pleasure line, paywall points and the adaptation boundary.

outline.title: Next: generate breakdowns for the first 12 episodes
outline.description: Generate a checkable episode outline first to confirm the direction of hooks, conflict and paywall points.

script.title: Next: generate episode {{order}}'s script
script.description: Write this episode's outline into a shootable drama script: dense dialogue, a hooked opening, a cliffhanger ending.

repair.title: Next: fix episode {{order}}'s quality issues
repair.description: This episode has quality suggestions; fix them first so issues don't reach the storyboard and video prompts.

review.title: Next: review episode {{order}}'s quality
review.description: Check the golden three seconds, information density, paywall points, duration, fact consistency and character consistency.

storyboard.title: Next: generate episode {{order}}'s storyboard
storyboard.description: Split the reviewed script into shootable shots, keeping character visual anchors and action focus.

videoPrompt.title: Next: generate episode {{order}}'s video prompts
videoPrompt.description: Turn one storyboard shot into a vertical video generation prompt, keeping character, action and camera language.

providerTask.title: Next: create a video generation task
providerTask.description: Send the generated video prompt to the current provider, then refresh status on the storyboard video page.

export.title: Next: export drama materials
export.description: Export the current characters, episodes, scripts, quality results and follow-up production materials for editing or handoff.
